integrity: The central stochastic Euler recurrence and existing signed-mean and squared-moment results are credited to prior work. Proof of the presented sharp pathwise and absolute-moment criterion is self-contained modulo standard SLLN, LIL and Borel-Cantelli.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar real decay, exponential iid waiting times, exact arithmetic and linear interpolation; no nonlinear/vector or alternative timestep law extension; historical priority cannot be conclusively established by search.
title: Exact pathwise and moment stability boundaries of exponential-clock Euler
